abstract: BACKGROUND: Teratomas of the greater omentum are rare. In most cases, they are composed of mature tissue elements and behave clinically in a benign fashion. CASE: A 62-year-old woman with a history of bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy due to ectopic pregnancy was found to have multiple cystic teratomas of the omentum. There was a histologic evidence of a sequential transition from benign through borderline to obviously invasive adenocarcinoma within the lining of the cysts as well as peritoneal dissemination. CONCLUSION: We defined the present case as malignant transformation of a mature teratoma, but have no evidence whatsoever for the origin of multiple mature teratomas. Further detailed analyses with more elaborated procedures on many relevant reports would be required to establish the origin and biologic behavior of teratomas of the omentum.
abstract_ja: 背景：大網の奇形腫は稀である。ほとんどの症例では成熟組織成分から構成され、臨床的には良性の経過をとる。症例：子宮外妊娠のため両側卵管卵巣摘出術の既往がある62歳女性に、大網の多発嚢胞性奇形腫が認められた。嚢胞の内張りにおいて良性から境界悪性を経て明らかな浸潤性腺癌へ連続的に移行する組織学的所見が認められ、腹膜播種も認められた。結論：本症例は成熟奇形腫の悪性転化と定義したが、複数の成熟奇形腫の発生起源については何ら根拠を認めない。大網奇形腫の起源と生物学的挙動を明らかにするには、関連する多数の報告についてより精密な解析手法を用いたさらなる詳細な検討が必要である。
